complaint_reply.yo: Ma binu fun iriri naa. Oṣiṣẹ atilẹyin yẹ ki o ṣe ayẹwo eyi gẹgẹ bi ẹdun. Lo oju-iwe atilẹyin Taja fun alaye afikun: {support_url}.

account_reply.en: Account-specific access or verification issues require a human review. Please contact Taja through the official support page and do not send passwords, PINs or OTPs: {support_url}.
account_reply.pcm: Account access or verification matter need support person. Contact Taja through official support page and no send password, PIN or OTP: {support_url}.

account_reply.ig: Nsogbu ịbanye n'akaụntụ ma ọ bụ nkwenye chọrọ onye ọrụ. Kpọtụrụ Taja site na ibe nkwado, ekekọrịtala password, PIN ma ọ bụ OTP: {support_url}.
account_reply.yo: Iṣoro wiwọle akọọlẹ tabi ijẹrisi nilo ayẹwo eniyan. Kan si Taja nipasẹ oju-iwe atilẹyin, maṣe fi ọrọ aṣina, PIN tabi OTP ranṣẹ: {support_url}.

ha: Ka gaya min game da Taja

answers.en: Taja is a cross-border finance platform for sending, receiving and managing money. Its public website lists multi-currency wallets, virtual accounts, payment requests, international payouts, crypto on-ramp and off-ramp services, and virtual cards.
answers.pcm: Taja na cross-border finance platform wey people fit use send, receive and manage money. Their public website list multi-currency wallets, virtual accounts, payment requests, international payouts, crypto on-ramp and off-ramp, plus virtual cards.
answers.ha: Taja dandamali ne na hada-hadar kuɗi tsakanin ƙasashe domin aikawa, karɓa da sarrafa kuɗi. Shafinta ya lissafo wallet na kuɗaɗe daban-daban, virtual accounts, neman kuɗi, payouts na ƙasashen waje, crypto on-ramp/off-ramp da virtual cards.
answers.ig: Taja bụ ikpo okwu ego gafee mba maka izipu, ịnata na ijikwa ego. Weebụsaịtị ya depụtara multi-currency wallets, virtual accounts, arịrịọ ịkwụ ụgwọ, payouts mba ofesi, crypto on-ramp/off-ramp na virtual cards.
answers.yo: Taja jẹ́ pẹpẹ ìṣúná ààlà-kọjá fun fifiranṣẹ, gbigba ati iṣakoso owo. Oju opo wẹẹbu rẹ darukọ multi-currency wallets, virtual accounts, payment requests, payouts kariaye, crypto on-ramp/off-ramp ati virtual cards.

en: How long does a transfer take?
ha: Yaya saurin canja wurin Taja yake?
ig: Kedu ngwa ngwa mbufe Taja dị?
Ogologo oge ole ka mbufe na-ewe?
yo: Bawo ni gbigbe owo Taja ṣe yara?
Igba melo ni gbigbe owo maa gba?

answers.en: Taja says transfers are delivered within minutes, and its public rate section shows an indicative arrival time of 1–5 minutes. Actual delivery can vary by destination, payment route, verification and operational checks, so confirm the current estimate in the app.
answers.pcm: Taja talk say transfer dey land within minutes, and their public rate page show 1–5 minutes as estimated arrival time. Real timing fit change because of destination, payment route, verification or checks, so confirm the current estimate for the app.
answers.ha: Taja ta ce canja wurin kuɗi yana isa cikin mintuna, kuma shafin farashinta ya nuna kimanin mintuna 1–5. Lokaci na ainihi na iya bambanta saboda ƙasa, hanyar biyan kuɗi, tantancewa ko wasu bincike; ka duba ƙiyasin yanzu a manhajar.
answers.ig: Taja kwuru na mbufe ego na-eru n'ime nkeji ole na ole, ibe ọnụego ya na-egosikwa nkeji 1–5 dị ka atụmatụ. Oge n'ezie nwere ike ịdị iche dabere na ebe a na-eziga, ụzọ ịkwụ ụgwọ, nkwenye na nyocha; lelee atụmatụ ọhụrụ n'ime ngwa.
answers.yo: Taja sọ pé gbigbe owo maa n de laarin iṣẹju diẹ, oju-iwe oṣuwọn rẹ si fihan iṣẹju 1–5 gẹgẹ bi akoko itọkasi. Akoko gangan le yato nitori ibi ti a n ranṣẹ si, ọna isanwo, ijẹrisi tabi ayẹwo; ṣayẹwo akoko lọwọlọwọ ninu app.

en: Can I convert crypto to cash?
How do I cash out crypto?
pcm: I fit convert crypto to cash?
How I go cash out crypto?
ha: Zan iya canza crypto zuwa kuɗi?
Ta yaya zan fitar da crypto zuwa cash?
ig: Enwere m ike ịgbanwe crypto ka ọ bụrụ ego?
Kedu ka m ga-esi cash out crypto?
yo: Ṣe mo le yi crypto pada si owo?
Bawo ni mo ṣe le cash out crypto?

answers.en: Yes. Taja’s public crypto page describes an off-ramp flow where you select the crypto asset, generate a Taja wallet address, send the crypto and receive cash in your bank account. Follow the current in-app instructions and rate shown before confirming a transaction.
answers.pcm: Yes. Taja public crypto page explain say you fit choose the crypto asset, generate Taja wallet address, send the crypto, then receive cash for your bank account. Follow the current steps and rate wey the app show before you confirm anything.
answers.ha: Eh. Shafin crypto na Taja ya bayyana cewa za ka zaɓi kadarar crypto, samar da adireshin wallet na Taja, aika crypto sannan ka karɓi kuɗi a asusun bankinka. Bi umarnin da farashin da manhajar ke nuna kafin ka tabbatar da ciniki.
answers.ig: Ee. Ibe crypto Taja kọwara na ị ga-ahọrọ akụ crypto, mepụta adreesị wallet Taja, zipu crypto, wee nata ego n'akaụntụ bankụ gị. Soro ntuziaka na ọnụego dị ugbu a n'ime ngwa tupu ị kwado azụmahịa.
answers.yo: Bẹẹni. Oju-iwe crypto Taja ṣalaye pe o le yan dukia crypto, ṣẹda adirẹsi wallet Taja, fi crypto ranṣẹ, lẹhinna gba owo sinu akọọlẹ banki rẹ. Tẹle ilana ati oṣuwọn lọwọlọwọ ninu app ki o to jẹrisi iṣowo.

en: Which countries can I send money to?
pcm: Which countries I fit send money go?
ha: Waɗanne ƙasashe zan iya aika kuɗi zuwa?
A ina Taja ke tallafa wa transfer?
ig: Kedu mba m nwere ike izigara ego?
yo: Awọn orilẹ-ede wo ni mo le fi owo ranṣẹ si?
Nibo ni Taja ṣe atilẹyin gbigbe owo?

answers.en: Taja says users can send money to more than 50 countries, including bank accounts, mobile wallets and cards where supported. Availability can vary by destination and payout method, so use the app to confirm the country and route currently available.
answers.pcm: Taja say users fit send money go more than 50 countries, including bank accounts, mobile wallets and cards where dem support am. Availability fit change by country and payout method, so check the app for the current route.
answers.ha: Taja ta ce masu amfani za su iya aika kuɗi zuwa fiye da ƙasashe 50, ciki har da asusun banki, mobile wallets da cards inda ake tallafa. Samuwa na iya bambanta da ƙasa da hanyar payout, don haka ka tabbatar a manhajar.
answers.ig: Taja kwuru na ndị ọrụ nwere ike iziga ego n'ihe karịrị mba 50, gụnyere akaụntụ bankụ, mobile wallets na cards ebe a na-akwado ha. Nnweta nwere ike ịdị iche dabere na mba na ụzọ payout, ya mere lelee ngwa maka ozi ọhụrụ.
answers.yo: Taja sọ pe awọn olumulo le fi owo ranṣẹ si ju orilẹ-ede 50 lọ, pẹlu awọn akọọlẹ banki, mobile wallets ati cards nibiti a ti ṣe atilẹyin. Wiwa le yato gẹgẹ bi orilẹ-ede ati ọna payout, nitorina ṣayẹwo app fun ọna lọwọlọwọ.

en: How does Taja protect my money?
pcm: How Taja dey protect my money?
ha: Ta yaya Taja ke kare kuɗina?
ig: Kedu ka Taja si echekwa ego m?
yo: Bawo ni Taja ṣe n daabo bo owo mi?

answers.en: Taja states that it uses security controls to protect funds and information, and its virtual-account page refers to compliance, encryption and fraud protection. You should still protect your account: never share your password, PIN, OTP, seed phrase, private key or full card details.
answers.pcm: Taja talk say e use security controls to protect money and information, and their virtual-account page mention compliance, encryption and fraud protection. Still protect your account: no share password, PIN, OTP, seed phrase, private key or full card details.
answers.ha: Taja ta ce tana amfani da matakan tsaro don kare kuɗi da bayanai, kuma shafin virtual account ya ambaci bin ƙa'idoji, encryption da kariya daga zamba. Ka kare asusunka: kada ka raba kalmar sirri, PIN, OTP, seed phrase, private key ko cikakken bayanin kati.
answers.ig: Taja kwuru na ọ na-eji usoro nchekwa echekwa ego na ozi, ibe virtual account ya kwukwara nrube isi, encryption na nchedo aghụghọ. Chekwaa akaụntụ gị: ekekọrịtala password, PIN, OTP, seed phrase, private key ma ọ bụ nkọwa kaadị zuru ezu.
answers.yo: Taja sọ pe o nlo awọn iṣakoso aabo lati daabo bo owo ati alaye, oju-iwe virtual account rẹ si darukọ ibamu ofin, encryption ati aabo lodi si jibiti. Daabo bo akọọlẹ rẹ: maṣe pin ọrọ aṣina, PIN, OTP, seed phrase, private key tabi alaye kaadi ni kikun.

en: How do I create a Taja account?
pcm: How I go create Taja account?
ha: Ta yaya zan ƙirƙiri asusun Taja?
ig: Kedu ka m ga-esi mepụta akaụntụ Taja?
yo: Bawo ni mo ṣe le bẹrẹ?
Bawo ni mo ṣe le ṣẹda akọọlẹ Taja?

answers.en: Download the Taja app and create an account. Complete the identity-verification steps shown in the app, add funds using an available local-currency or crypto route, then choose the service or recipient you need. Requirements and availability can depend on your location and verification status.
answers.pcm: Download Taja app and create account. Complete the identity verification wey the app show, add money with any local-currency or crypto route wey dey available, then choose the service or person wey you wan send to. Requirements fit depend on your location and verification status.
answers.ha: Sauke manhajar Taja ka ƙirƙiri asusu. Kammala matakan tantancewa da manhajar ta nuna, ƙara kuɗi ta hanyar local currency ko crypto da ke samuwa, sannan ka zaɓi sabis ko wanda kake son aikawa. Bukatu na iya dogara da wurinka da matsayin tantancewa.
answers.ig: Budata ngwa Taja ma mepụta akaụntụ. Mezue usoro nkwenye njirimara dị n'ime ngwa, tinye ego site na local currency ma ọ bụ crypto dị, wee họrọ ọrụ ma ọ bụ onye ịchọrọ izigara. Ihe achọrọ nwere ike ịdabere na ebe ị nọ na ọnọdụ nkwenye gị.
answers.yo: Gba app Taja silẹ ki o ṣẹda akọọlẹ. Pari awọn igbesẹ ijẹrisi idanimọ ninu app, fi owo kun nipasẹ local currency tabi ọna crypto ti o wa, lẹhinna yan iṣẹ tabi olugba. Awọn ibeere le dale lori ipo rẹ ati ipo ijẹrisi rẹ.

answers.pcm: Use Taja official contact page to send message or see their current support channels: https://www.tajahq.com/contact. No send password, PIN, OTP, seed phrase, private key or full card details.
answers.ha: Yi amfani da shafin tuntuɓar Taja don aika saƙo ko ganin hanyoyin tallafi na yanzu: https://www.tajahq.com/contact. Kada ka aika kalmar sirri, PIN, OTP, seed phrase, private key ko cikakken bayanin kati.
answers.ig: Jiri ibe kọntaktị Taja zipu ozi ma ọ bụ hụ ụzọ nkwado dị ugbu a: https://www.tajahq.com/contact. Ekekọrịtala password, PIN, OTP, seed phrase, private key ma ọ bụ nkọwa kaadị zuru ezu.
